name: Mimasaka Kouzukenosuke
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
He is a member of the Anime and Manga Research Society, and as a part of it, he is a genuine anime and manga geek.
Does not even try to listen to the opinions of other people, it is often said that while he speaks, he no longer notices anyone around him.
